summary: catalog: OUTCOME_SUPPORTING_STEP = finalised; battle evidence gains outcome_supported (+ reason), and the tier stops at the furthest step reached. runner: generic downgrade of VERIFIED to UNKNOWN when evidence reports outcome_supported false (other actions unaffected), with the evidence rebuilt. battles_from_events: win/loss also requires error_class None; start times normalised to UTC before schedule lookup. Regression tests in tests/test_battle_results_from_journal.py fail on the old code (5 failures, 2 errors) and pass now. Implemented by a subagent in a worktree; re-validated by the parent.

contract_status_changes.before: A failed battle call plus an unrelated trophy change was journaled verified and reported as a win; non-UTC journal times crashed the battle report
contract_status_changes.after: Only a finalised battle with an observed trophy change is verified; other trophy changes leave the outcome unknown, and any timezone-aware journal time works
proof: reviewer repro now journals unknown with tier request-sent and reports unknown
regression tests fail on the previous code and pass now

residual_risks: A trophy change from a defense during a finalised attack is still attributed to the attack; separating them needs a verified battle-history read.
